description.fun: Marshadow went undiscovered for so long that it was thought to be just a myth. It hides in other people's shadows, where it can sense their feelings and copy their moves, until it becomes stronger than whoever it's imitating, even mastering the ultimate techniques of martial arts masters. When its fighting spirit burns, its headgear and collar flare up like green flames.
description.guide: Marshadow is a Fighting- and Ghost-type Mythical Pokémon from Alola that lurks in shadows. It copies the abilities of those whose shadows it hides in, and it is the only Pokémon that learns Spectral Thief. It may be based on shadowboxing.
description.tagline: A shadowboxing ghost that copies you from your own shadow
